_comment: Tier-2 CORRECTION: pitfall (kratos.auxiliary_overview #5) states that BOTH KratosContactStructuralMechanicsApplication (modern) AND the legacy KratosContactMechanicsApplication / KratosSolidMechanicsApplication are NOT published on PyPI, and that 'there is no pip-only path to Contact physics in Kratos 10.x'. THE FIRST HALF IS FALSE at 10.4.3: pip installs KratosContactStructuralMechanicsApplication==10.4.3 and import KratosMultiphysics.ContactStructuralMechanicsApplication succeeds. Executed on Kratos 10.4.3 (pip wheels, glibc-2.31 host, fresh venv on external ext4 image). The LEGACY half of the claim stands — ContactMechanicsApplication and SolidMechanicsApplication both raise ModuleNotFoundError and have no wheel at any version. This fixture pins the corrected state: modern contact IS pip-reachable, legacy contact is not. The fixture imports KratosMultiphysics at module scope; with Kratos absent the import raises, the process exits non-zero and the runner records a failure, never a pass. MUTATION CONTROL (added 2026-08-06, re-runnable): T2_MUTATE=1 INVERTS every claimed availability flag in CASES -- it asserts the opposite of what this install actually provides, leaving the importlib.import_module probe itself untouched. All 4 importable[...] lines then disagree with themselves and app_import_mismatches goes from 0 to 4. This is the control the fixture needs: it proves the printed booleans come from a real import attempt on this build and that a wrong availability claim is caught, rather than the fixture echoing a hard-coded table. Verified: unmutated the fixture PASSES; with T2_MUTATE=1 it FAILS and these expect_in_output strings disappear: all 4 importable[<app>]=<got>_expected=<must> lines, app_import_mismatches=0. Re-verify: cd scripts/tier2_fixtures/kratos/contact_application_is_on_pypi_after_all && /usr/bin/python3 source.py (passes), then T2_MUTATE=1 /usr/bin/python3 source.py (fails). Interpreter: KRATOS_PYTHON=/usr/bin/python3 is REQUIRED on this host -- the repo venv Kratos wheel is built against GLIBC_2.32 and fails to load (ImportError on Kratos.cpython-312...so), while the system python3.8 carries Kratos 10.4 Release with CableNet, ConstitutiveLaws, StructuralMechanics and LinearSolvers.
_key_correction: The fixture's physics field says '_auxiliary_overview', with a leading underscore; the registry key that get_knowledge() answers to is 'auxiliary_overview' without one. The fallback key '_auxiliary_overview::5' therefore named no claim and this fixture credited nothing, while the claim it verifies sat uncovered. Adding an explicit covers list fixes the link without touching the physics field that the runner groups by. Index confirmed against the claim text.
